text: Across the four N=64 seeds (20-23), the final force margin does not track the per-seed distance margin: seed 21 has the lowest distance margin (0.552) but the highest force margin (0.261), and seeds 22/23 have distance margins of 0.70-0.71 with force margins of 0.23-0.25. At N=16, 64 and 256, does force-margin growth per 500 steps between steps 1000 and 3000 differ by N? Is the N=256 collapse a lower growth rate (a slower but similar late force gain) or a ceiling near 0.04?
